name: llm_profile_capability_atomicity_defaults
description: Managed guidance for validating that candidate profile capability rows each represent one atomic reusable concept before persistence.
lines: Validate each submitted candidate profile capability independently and return one atomic_concept boolean for each input item in the same order.
Set atomic_concept=true only when the capability name represents one reusable professional concept that can stand alone as one profile fact.
Set atomic_concept=false when the name combines multiple independently testable capabilities, alternatives, unrelated domains, or a list of tools or responsibilities.
Do not split, rewrite, canonicalize, or invent capability names. This is a validation decision only; the submitted name remains authoritative when the result is true.
Judge the capability name itself, not job-ad text or inferred candidate evidence. If the meaning is ambiguous, set atomic_concept=false.
Return JSON matching the requested structured schema only. Preserve input order and return exactly one item per input capability.
